# M1 test cases

The 66 cases [M1 Identity](/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m1) is tested against. They cover ABHA creation by Aadhaar OTP, Aadhaar biometric, demographic authentication and driving licence or PAN, then verification, profile update, one ABHA per patient record, and sharing a profile by QR code.
Each case keeps the id the functional testing report uses.

Every call a case names has its full request in the [M1 Identity API reference](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1).
Every call needs a gateway session first: [`POST /api/hiecm/gateway/v3/sessions`](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-abdm-sessions/01-gateway-post-gateway-v3-sessions).
An AI coding assistant can walk these cases against your own system with the [M1 Identity skill](/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m1#build-m1-with-an-ai-coding-assistant).

## 1\. ABHA Creation Through Aadhaar OTP

Applies to: All.

### CRT_ABHA_101: Create ABHA Option {#crt_abha_101}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** The system must provide an option to create ABHA through Aadhaar OTP
- **Expected result:** User will have an option to create ABHA
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/enrollment/request/otp`, `/abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/byAadhaar`, `/abha/api/v3/enrollment/auth/byAbdm`, `/abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/suggestion`, `/abha/api/v3/enrollment/enrol/abha-address`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/account`, [`GET /abha/api/v3/profile/account/abha-card`](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-abha-card-profile/02-m1-get-v3-profile-account-abha-card)

### CRT_ABHA_102: Consent collection {#crt_abha_102}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:**
  - The system must display the consent language/ disclaimer language and collect user's consent as per the ABDM published consent.
  - Refer Cell No-: M14
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Read consent language
  - 2\. Agree to the consent language (through 'I agree' checkbox or any other form of signature)
- **Expected result:**
  - User provides consent for sharing of Aadhaar details and creation of ABHA.
  - System records user consent for compliance with Health Data Management Policy.
- **For the tester:** Please refer the approved consent language.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_103: Suggestions:- Consent collection should be multilingual {#crt_abha_103}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** The system should be able to provide the consent in languages other than English also
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Read consent language
  - 2\. Agree to the consent language (through 'I agree' checkbox or any other form of signature)
- **Expected result:**
  - User provides consent for sharing of Aadhaar details and creation of ABHA.
  - System records user consent for compliance with Health Data Management Policy.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_104: Aadhaar collection and Error Message {#crt_abha_104}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System must allow the user to enter Aadhaar Number and the system will display an error message for invalid Aadhaar Number
- **Steps:** 1\. Enter Aadhaar number
- **Expected result:**
  - User is prompted to enter correct Aadhaar Number
  - In case user enters an invalid Aadhaar number (A valid Aadhaar is a 12-digit number), the system shows an error message "Aadhaar Number is not valid".
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_105: Aadhaar OTP Collection {#crt_abha_105}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** User receives Aadhaar OTP and System must allow the user to enter Aadhaar OTP.
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Receive OTP on mobile number registered with Aadhaar
  - 2\. Enter Aadhaar OTP
- **Expected result:**
  - User will be able to enter a valid Aadhaar OTP (A valid Aadhaar OTP is a 6-digit number).
  - Example -
  - Modified text for the "Please enter 6 -digit OTP sent to Aadhaar linked mobile number " step during the ABHA Creation workflow with “We just sent an OTP on the Mobile Number \*\*\*\*\*\*\*XXXX linked with Aadhaar. Enter the OTP below to proceed with ABHA creation".
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_106: Resend OTP {#crt_abha_106}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System may activate the Resend OTP button maximum 2 times after 60 seconds
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Click on Resend OTP Button
  - 2\. Receive OTP on mobile
- **Expected result:** User will able to send OTP again and verify it
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_107: OTP based Aadhaar Authentication {#crt_abha_107}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System must verify the OTP
- **Steps:**
  - Click on verify button (For Resend and Send)
  - It is recommended that verify button be auto enabled
- **Expected result:**
  - System authenticates the user's Aadhaar through OTP
  - In case of incorrect OTP, the system displays an error
  - In case of correct OTP, the system allows the user to proceed
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_108: Communication Mobile Number verification-I {#crt_abha_108}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:**
  - 1\. If communication mobile number is same as Aadhaar linked mobile number then it should directly go to ABHA creation screen .
  - 2\. Alternatively , Integrators may also prompt for OTP again from the user and then post verification of OTP user can go to ABHA creation screen.
- **Steps:**
  - This is applicable for testcase cell no -G20 , point no-1
  - 1\. System will check entered mobile is same as Aadhaar linked mobile number. If returns true then user will directed to ABHA creation screen.
  - 2\. For point number 2 step are already mentioned in test case cell no- G20 , point no-2
- **Expected result:** Redirect to the ABHA creation screen.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_109: Communication Mobile Number verification-II {#crt_abha_109}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** If communication mobile number is not same as Aadhaar linked mobile number then system must ask for the OTP to verify comuncation mobile number.
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. System must verify the mobile number.
  - 1\. System must send OTP on mobile number
  - 2\. User enters the OTP and clicks on verify
  - 3\. In case of incorrect OTP, the system displays an error
  - 4\. In case of correct OTP, the system allows the user to proceed
- **Expected result:** System verifies the communication mobile number
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_112: Suggested ABHA Address {#crt_abha_112}

- **Marking:** Mandatory for Private /Government (Optional for integrated program using demo auth as they have default ABHA address generated)
- **Test:**
  - 1\. The system should allow the user to select the ABHA address giving atleast 3 available suggestions
  - 2\. Otherwise the system should have a provision to create a ABHA address with ABHA address Policy and validation rule should be print beside the field where ABHA Address is entered.
  - Validation rules on ABHA Address to be set at the API level:
  - 1\. Minimum length - 8 characters
  - 2\. Maximum length - 18 characters
  - 3\. Special characters allowed - 1 dot (.) and/or 1 underscore (_)
  - 4\. Special character dot and underscore should be in between. Special characters cannot be in the beginning or at the end
  - 5\. Alphanumeric - only numbers, only letters or any combination of numbers and letters is allowed.
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Governemnt integrator may use the option for creating default ABHA address. However, it is recommended that user-defined or system suggested ABHA address be used
  - 2\. System should have a provision for private integrators to proceed with the suggested ABHA address.
  - 3\. If beneficary use the existing ABHA address then system displays the "ABHA Address is already exist".
- **Expected result:** System should prompt / display the available or suggested ABHA addresses. System should allow the user to proceed with the enterered ABHA Address. In case, entered ABHA address is already in use then system should allow the user to input and proceed with any one of the suggested ABHA address.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_113: Display of ABHA Number {#crt_abha_113}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System must display the created ABHA Number
- **Steps:** 1\. System shows the 14-digit ABHA number and ABHA address generated
- **Expected result:** User should be able to view the generated ABHA Number and linked ABHA address
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_114: View and Download ABHA details. (If integrators is generating ABHA card) {#crt_abha_114}

- **Marking:** Mandatory for Private
- **Test:** System must have a provision to View / Download ABHA card
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. System should show the user their ABHA Card
  - 2\. ABHA Card should be generated by API and should contain -
  - a. ABHA Number (Mandatory)
  - b. User Photo-Optional
  - c. ABHA QR code
  - d. date of birth and gender
  - e. ABHA Address
- **Expected result:** User should be able to view their ABHA Card with all the demographc details as mentioned in cell H26
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_115: View and Download ABHA details. (If integrators is not generating ABHA card) {#crt_abha_115}

- **Marking:** Either of the test cases CRT_ABHA_114 or CRT_ABHA_115 is mandatory for Governement Optional for Private
- **Test:** System must have a provision to View details like ABHA number and ABHA address in the card (either ABHA card or any card being generated for their program/scheme/entity)
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. If Integrator is not generating ABHA card then They print the mentioned information on their program/scheme or any other card
  - a. ABHA Number (Mandatory)
  - b. ABHA Address
- **Expected result:** User should be able to view card with ABHA number and ABHA address and the details should be saved in HIMS system and linked with the HIMS unique beneficary 's ID.g or as per their business requirement.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_305: Demographic Information based authentication {#crt_abha_305}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System must verify the demographic information of the user against their Aadhaar
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Enter beneficiary's name, date of birth, gender, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Address, State name, and district name in accordance with the details on their Aadhaar card.
  - 2\. Case 1:If the beneficiary has an existing ABHA address, it should be displayed on both the ABHA card and the ABHA profile.
  - OR
  - Case 2: If beneficary want to create a customize ABHA address then same ABHA address should be displayed on both the ABHA card and the ABHA profile.
  - 3 : Case 3 : If the beneficiary have no ABHA address then system will create a Default ABHA Address ( ABHA Number @sbx) and same ABHA address should be displayed on both the ABHA card and the ABHA profile. (Mandatory )
  - 4\. If a beneficiary's deatils are matched with Aadhaaar information then system will not allow to create ABHA.
  - 5\. If If a beneficiary's deatils are matched with Aadhaaar information then system will allow to create ABHA .
- **Expected result:**
  - 1\. System authenticates the user's Aadhaar though user's demographic data.
  - 2\.The fields for name, date of birth, and gender are set as non-editable, while the remaining fields can be open for editing i.e (Address, Email , Mobile Number, State, district , City e.t.c)
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_306: Profile Completion {#crt_abha_306}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System should accepts user's profile information -
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. System auto-populates beneficiary's name, date of birth, gender, Aadhaar number, mobile number, address, state name, district name
  - and ABHA Number.
  - 2\.The fields for name, date of birth, and gender are set as non-editable, while the remaining fields can be open for editing.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** System must have a provision to View / Download ABHA card
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. System should show the user their ABHA Card
  - 2\. ABHA Card should be generated by API and should contain -
  - a. ABHA Number (Mandatory)
  - b. User Photo-Optional
  - c. ABHA QR code
  - d. date of birth and gender
  - e. ABHA Address
- **Expected result:** User should be able to view their ABHA Card and the details should be saved in HIMS system and linked with the HIMS unique beneficary 's ID.g or as per their business requirement.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

### CRT_ABHA_411: View and Download ABHA details. (If integrators is not generating ABHA card) {#crt_abha_411}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** If Integrator is not generating ABHA card.

## 5\. ABHA Verification

Applies to: All.

### VRFY_ABHA_101: ABHA Number Verification using Aadhaar OTP {#vrfy_abha_101}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System must allow ABHA Number verification using Aadhaar OTP
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Share ABHA Number or ABHA Address
  - 2\. Receive OTP on the Aadhaar linked mobile number
  - 3\. Enter the OTP.
  - 4\. System may activate the Resend OTP button maximum 2 times after 60 seconds in the OTP not received.
  - 5\. If beneficiary updates their mobile number in the HIMS system and It is advisable to provide users with the option to update their mobile number in the ABHA profile with (Yes/No) using the profile API you should be able to update the details.
- **Expected result:**
  - 1\. In case of correct OTP, the verification is complete and the System can fetch user's ABHA profile - name, date of birth, gender, mobile number, photo and address, ABHA Number , ABHA Address and other details from the APIs.
  - 2\. In case of incorrect OTP, the verification fails.
  - 3\. The fields for name, date of birth, and gender are set as non-editable, while the remaining fields can be open for editing i.e (Address, Email , Mobile Number, State, district , City e.t.c)
  - 4\. After verification , the details should be saved in HIMS system and linked with the HIMS unique beneficary 's ID.g or as per their business requirement.
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/profile/login/request/otp`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/account`, [`GET /abha/api/v3/profile/account/abha-card`](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-abha-card-profile/02-m1-get-v3-profile-account-abha-card)

### VRFY_ABHA_102: ABHA Address Verification using Aadhaar OTP {#vrfy_abha_102}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** System must allow ABHA Address verification using Aadhaar OTP
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Share ABHA Number or ABHA Address.
  - 2\. Receive OTP on the Aadhaar linked mobile number.
  - 3\. Enter the OTP.
  - 4\. System may activate the Resend OTP button maximum 2 times after 60 seconds in the OTP not received.
  - 5\. If beneficiary updates their mobile number in the HIMS system and It is advisable to provide users with the option to update their mobile number in the ABHA profile with (Yes/No) using the profile API you should be able to update the details.
- **Expected result:**
  - 1\. In case of correct OTP, the verification is complete and the System can fetch user's ABHA profile - name, date of birth, gender, mobile number, photo and address, , state,district, ABHA Number , ABHA Address and other details from the APIs.
  - 2\. In case of incorrect OTP, the verification fails.
  - 3\. The fields for name, date of birth, and gender are set as non-editable, while the remaining fields can be open for editing i.e (Address, Email , Mobile Number, State, district , City e.t.c)
  - 4\. After verification , the details should be saved in HIMS system and linked with the HIMS unique beneficary 's ID.g or as per their business requirement.
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/phr/web/login/abha/search`, `/abha/api/v3/phr/web/login/abha/request/otp`, `/abha/api/v3/phr/web/login/abha/verify`, `/abha/api/v3/phr/web/login/profile/abha-profile`, `/abha/api/v3/phr/web/login/profile/abha/phr-card`

- **Marking:** Mandatory

- **Steps:** 1\. Incase ABHA Details not exists to communicated Mobile Number in ABHA system.
- **Expected result:**
  - System will display an error message i.e.

  - We did not find any ABHA number linked to this mobile number.

### VRFY_ABHA_303: VRFY_ABHA_303 {#vrfy_abha_303}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** ABHA Details exists to communicated Mobile Number.
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Incase ABHA Details exists to communicated Mobile Number.
  - 1\.1. If ABHA Details exists to comunication mobile number exists in ABHA system , In case ' Yes' then system will display a message "ABHA Exists to communication Mobile" and user will receive the OTP i.e "OTP sent to ABHA linked mobile number ending with \*\*\*\*\*\*XXXX" and then Upon verification completion, the system will display a list of ABHA numbers linked to the mobile number, including the following details: Name, ABHA Number, ABHA Address, and the beneficiary's photograph. When the user attempts to link selected ABHA details, the system will verify if the selected record is present in the HIMS system. If so, it will display a message indicating that the record is already linked in the HIMS with the HIMS beneficiary's ID.
  - 1\.2 If the selected ABHA Profile is not present in HIMS, the system will allow it to be Register and linked in their HIMS beneficary's ID or proceed as per bussiness requirement OR benefciary can download the ABHA card (Optional)
- **Expected result:**
  - 1\. Fetching ABHA Details.
  - 2\. Register and Linked in their HIMS OR OR benefciary can download the ABHA card.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

## 9\. ABHA Verification (Applicable for Government Entites)

### VRFY_ABHA_501: ABHA Number verification using Aadhaar Biometric - Fingerprint {#vrfy_abha_501}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** System must allow ABHA Number verification using Biometric scan
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Share ABHA Number or ABHA Address
  - 2\. Scan fingerprint or face
- **Expected result:**
  - In case the biometrics match, the verification is complete and the System can fetch user's ABHA profile - name, date of birth, gender, mobile number, photo and address, ABHA Number , ABHA Address and other details from the APIs.
  - In case the biometrics do not match, the verification fails.
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/account`, [`GET /abha/api/v3/profile/account/abha-card`](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-abha-card-profile/02-m1-get-v3-profile-account-abha-card)

### PROF_ABHA_601: Mobile Update {#prof_abha_601}

- **Marking:** Optional

- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Enter new mobile number
  - 2\. Enter OTP
  - 3\. Enter Password/ OTP on old mobile number
- **Expected result:** Mobile number on ABHA profile is updated
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/request/otp`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/verify`

### PROF_ABHA_602: Photo Update {#prof_abha_602}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** System must allow the user to update their Photo
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Click on Edit Photo
  - 2\. Upload new photo
- **Expected result:** Photo on ABHA profile is updated
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/profile/account`

### PROF_ABHA_603: Email Update {#prof_abha_603}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** System must allow the user to update their Email
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Enter new Email ID
  - 2\. Enter OTP
- **Expected result:** Email ID on ABHA profile is updated
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/request/otp`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/verify`

### PROF_ABHA_604: Re-KYC {#prof_abha_604}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** System must allow the user to perform re-KYC
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Click on re-KYC option
  - 2\. Enter OTP received on Aadhaar linked mobile numer
- **Expected result:** KYC details on ABHA profile are updated
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/request/otp`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/verify`

### PROF_ABHA_605: Delete ABHA {#prof_abha_605}

- **Marking:** Optional
- **Test:** System must allow the user to Delete/ Deactivate ABHA
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Click on Delete/ Deactivate ABHA
  - 2\. Enter OTP received on mobile number to confirm deletion/ deactivation
  - 3\. Try to login again using the same ABHA
- **Expected result:**
  - ABHA Number should be deleted.
  - The system should not allow login through the same ABHA
- **Calls:** `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/request/otp`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/account/verify`, `/abha/api/v3/profile/login/request/otp`, [`POST /abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify/user`](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-login-mobile-number/03-m1-post-v3-profile-login-verify-user)

## 16\. Verify one ABHA Number is linked to the unique patient ID in HIMS

Applies to: All.

### TAGGING_UNIQUEPATIENTID_UNIQUEABHANUMBER: Verify one ABHA Number is linked to the unique patient ID in HIMS {#tagging_uniquepatientid_uniqueabhanumber}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** Intergrator's HIMS System should allow tagging of one ABHA Number with unique patient Id.
- **Steps:**
  - ABHA Number should be validated in the database if already exists before creating a new patient id to avoid tagging of multiple patient id with same ABHA Number.
  - Kindly Note: This test scenario is applicable for both new and existing beneficiaries and linking will be happens with ABHA creation and verification flow.
- **Expected result:** HIMS is able to tag Patient ID with ABHA number.
- **Calls:** none. This case is checked on your screens or in your records.

## 17\. Share Profile

Applies to: PHR app Mandatory.

### SHARE_PATIENT_PROFILE_701: Share Patient Profile {#share_patient_profile_701}

- **Marking:** Mandatory
- **Test:** User will scan the QR code which is placed the facility premises
- **Steps:**
  - 1\. Log into PHR app.
  - 2\. User will scan the QR code which is placed at the facility premises/registration desk.
  - 3\. Post scanning, patient profile details are displayed including ABHA number, ABHA address, Name, Gender, DoB, Mobile No and Address. Below this consent language is displayed - "Your consent to the above information to be shared with \<HIP Name\>. They can use this information for your registration and linking your health records" and both "Cancel" / "Share" buttons are provided.
  - 4\.Check that after clicking on "Share" button, user profile is successfully shared with the HIP and if user click on "Cancel" button then user profile is not shared with the HIP.
  - 5\. User clicks on share and gets a token number.
  - 6\. User clicks on ok and gets token number with validity of 30 minutes.
- **Expected result:**
  - 1\. Log into PHR app.
  - 2\. User will scan the QR code which is placed at the facility premises/registration desk.
  - 3\. Post scanning, patient profile details are displayed including ABHA number, ABHA address, Name, Gender, DoB, Mobile No and Address. Below this consent language is displayed - "Your consent to the above information to be shared with \<HIP Name\>. They can use this information for your registration and linking your health records" and both "Cancel" / "Share" buttons are provided.
  - 4\.Check that after clicking on "Share" button, user profile is successfully shared with the HIP and if user click on "Cancel" button then user profile is not shared with the HIP.
  - 5\. User clicks on share and gets a token number.
  - 6\. User clicks on ok and gets token number with validity of 30 minutes.
- **Calls:** [`POST /api/hiecm/patient-share/v3/on-share`](/docs/hiecm/v3/api/scan-and-register/endpoints/scan-and-register-abdm-patient-share-hip/02-scan-and-register-post-patient-share-v3-on-share)
